in_marathi.name: Neeti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neeti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neeti refers to the principles of morality and conduct as mentioned in the ancient Indian text, The Mahabharata. The term is derived from the Sanskrit word 'neetayati', which means 'to guide'. Neeti represents the wisdom and knowledge that guides one through life.
